candidates.statement: Checkout returns 502 because the order service's call to payment times out: traces show POST payment to /v1/authorizations failing with transport ReadTimeout (~2s), propagating to POST order and POST /v1/checkout 502s. Gateway /v1/checkout p95 is ~2425ms with 16 502s per 60s.
candidates.uncertainty: Payment-side latency metrics/logs are not in evidence; the timeout is inferred from client-side spans only.

report.explanation: Traces consistently show payment authorization ReadTimeouts cascading to order and checkout 502s, matching downstream-latency. Payment-side telemetry is absent, so the bounded candidate is stated but not fully substantiated.
missing_evidence: Payment service latency/error metrics and server-side spans for /v1/authorizations to confirm payment slowness vs. network timeout
Gateway/order logs (ev-...-gw-logs excluded) to corroborate timeout errors
